name: Household Chore Rotation
description: Rotate household chores fairly: daily / weekly / interval repeats, rotation lists, check-offs, late make-ups and weekly stats
help: Add family nicknames first, then chores: repeat daily, on chosen weekdays or every few days, with a fixed assignee or a rotation list.
Each chore rotates on its own list; the rotation advances by planned occurrences, so late check-offs never shift other days.
Checking off records the actual executor and time, mistakes can be undone and repeated clicks never double count; skips and completions are counted separately.
Late make-ups stay on the original planned date while keeping the actual date; rule or list changes only take effect from the chosen day, history is preserved.
Temporarily reassign one occurrence, pause chores, and copy or export the weekly table and a JSON backup.

rota.summary: List who is on duty for each date from a rotation and a repeat rule
